scope: First-pass end-to-end static review of the pinned port main paths, cross-checked against runtime reports and IOFramebuffer API docs. Not a line-by-line audit of all Linux/FreeBSD/Mesa code.
hardware_proven: UHD 770 PCI matching and i915 attach progressed.
H610 LPC discovery and PCH_ADP selection work after the enumeration repair.
Both HPD tables initialize; GEM/display probe and scan-out allocation complete.
Generic scan-out vmap is refused; no usable framebuffer was published.
The system can keep running after signal loss.
candidate_repairs_not_hardware_verified: Use CPU-mappable GGTT scan-out and balance pins/VMA/wake references.
Validate the framebuffer range before exposing it to macOS.
Retain the original guard on both port attach and framebuffer publication failure; remove the claim on failed publication.
Initialize framebuffer allocation bounds before drm_client_register synchronously invokes hotplug, and preserve callback errors.
Disable FBC on the diagnostic Alder Lake-S path because direct WindowServer writes do not implement Linux frontbuffer damage notifications.
Implement software VBL registration/enable/disable/unregister with in-flight target references and stop/rearm synchronization.
Retry preferred/1080p/720p/1024x768 bounds on reported capacity/modeset errors, with atomic checks and mapping cleanup between attempts.
Track registered-client ownership: an initial registration callback failure keeps pins until DRM unregister instead of freeing an owned client.
Synchronize attach cancellation, power/shutdown operations and detach; never free a device after a timed wait while its probe still runs.
Reject failed framebuffer power transitions instead of acknowledging them as successful.
Normalize packed 1/3-channel 8/16-bit IOFramebuffer gamma tables and commit through the existing DRM legacy-to-atomic color path.
Treat CLUT as unsupported for the sole direct XRGB8888 format; validate connection/color-depth requests and report failed power changes.
Only signal attach completion after its final stage logging, so stop cannot tear down shared services while attach still logs.
Retain native IRQ work loops under the BSD interrupt-list lock; draining no longer dereferences a cookie that teardown can free.
Reject zero/wrapping DMA ranges, unsafe IOKit mapping spans, oversized page lists and bus-DMA total sizes before exposing an address.
Copy real connector EDID and progressive timings into a stable-ID one-display snapshot; reject invalid EDID and modes outside the immutable scanout allocation.
Implement native DDC/mode enumeration, atomic interactive mode commits with rollback, and generation-based connection notifications.
Serialize hotplug, mode switch, gamma and power transactions; mode catalog replacement runs through IOFramebuffer configuration probing rather than asynchronously racing count/enumeration.
known_display_limitations: Software VBL callback lifetime now has a real implementation and host concurrency tests; real hardware IRQ pacing remains unverified.
VBL is software timed; real display IRQ pacing is unverified.
Gamma now has a DRM atomic commit implementation and host conversion/error tests; visible color behavior remains hardware-unverified. Indexed CLUT is not applicable to the advertised direct format.

Single-connector dynamic modes/DDC/notification code is implemented. Only progressive modes inside the original scanout dimensions are exposed; allocation growth, multiple outputs and interlaced/doublescan/3D modes are unsupported.
The GGTT mapping candidate intentionally holds an awake reference; sleep/wake is not established.
acceleration_gaps: The tested install path installs the NMXGPU display/DRM layer only.
The inspected Intel package includes NMXAccel but not the NVMTLDriver bundle it references.
ANV GPU mappings, real submission/readback, Metal and accelerated WindowServer have no success evidence on this hardware.
Kernel mmap ioctl support exists, but that alone does not verify the userland ANV/libdrm calling path.
Current plugin/NVMTLDevice.m::nvmtl_process_is_allowed explicitly rejects WindowServer for non-NVIDIA vendors before NVMTL_ENABLE or the allow-list.
plugin/nvmtl_vk.c::nvmtl_gpu_headless treats Intel as app-only and disables the NVIDIA IOSurface family-sharing/page-off path.

Public Metal frontend source and historical Mesa/libdrm Darwin patches exist. Completing the Intel package and WindowServer resource/presentation contracts is additional work, not simply clearing the process check.
api_checked_not_a_bug: IOFramebuffer.getPixelFormatsForDisplayMode returning zero is required by its Apple header; it is not an unsupported-format bug.
The public IOGraphics color definitions confirm RGB mode bit 0x1 and 8-bit RGB depth bit 0x2; those existing answers were not a color-enumeration bug.

IOService normal provider termination finalizes clients before provider stop; nmx_fb_unpublish is only called from that stop path. This does not certify arbitrary manual stop or native runtime lock ordering.
source_flow_review: xnu/nmx_kext.cpp: opted_in, start/attachThread/attachNow, boot guard, claim, power and stop ordering.
bsdcompat/src/nmx_port.c and nmx_bus.c: attach_on, child driver selection, native PCI class discovery and detach ownership.
i915_driver.c, intel_display_driver.c, intel_opregion.c, intel_hotplug_irq.c and intel_ddi.c: probe stages, optional OpRegion, PCH/HPD and tunnel configuration.
drm_client.c and drm_client_modeset.c: framebuffer allocation, callback ownership, synchronous registration hotplug and probe bounds.
intel_fb_pin.c, i915_vma.c and nmx_i915_scanout.c: GGTT placement, aperture mapping, VMA/fence/object/wake reference pairing.
intel_fbc.c, intel_frontbuffer.c and intel_fbdev.c: compression policy and missing damage/invalidate/flush integration for the macOS aperture writer.

xnu/nmx_fb.cpp and Apple IOFramebuffer.cpp/.h: range and mode APIs, software VBL, interrupt registration and stop/unpublish ordering. Software callback hardening is implemented and host-tested; hardware VBL and dynamic connector delivery remain outstanding.
Acceleration package boundary: NMXGPU display publication is separate from NMXAccel, ANV/libdrm, the missing Metal frontend and real GPU execution. This is not a full Mesa or memory/IRQ-shim audit.

compilation_evidence.result: 900 DRM/AMD + 274 i915 + 76 runtime units compiled, all host fixtures passed, required symbol definitions verified, temporary native auxiliary kernel collection created and inspected successfully. No driver was installed/loaded and no hardware was tested.

validation_order: Pinned patches/apply checks and host fixtures
All macOS kernel sources compile and binary/source provenance verified
Recovery is concrete before enabling a one-attempt test
One instrumented basic-display test covering map/commit/publication/visible output
Separate acceleration tests only after its dependencies and protocol are available
policy: No more one-reboot-per-return-code instructions. Batch statically established fixes first. Do not promise one hardware test can prove complete support.

host_verification.platform: Windows MSVC 2022 with /W4 /WX; actual patched helper headers and complete bridge function bodies, mocked IOKit/DRM services only
host_verification.callback_lifetime: Passed dispatch, disable, invalid handles, concurrent/self unregister, retained targets and stop/rearm checks
host_verification.display_bridge: Passed 18 fault/ownership/mode scenarios, including registered-client failure, partial allocation and generic AMD mapping
host_verification.attach_lifetime: Passed cancellation/admission/drain checks and 200 concurrent completion/stop races
host_verification.limits: These tests do not model IOKit scheduling, actual DRM locking, GPU/IOMMU transactions or visible output. macOS compilation is a separate gate.
host_verification.gamma: Passed 1/3-channel 8/16-bit, interpolation, unaligned input, maximum/invalid metadata and bridge commit/error tests
host_verification.irq_drain: Passed filtering, reference balancing and cookie teardown injected immediately after list unlock in the actual patched BSD drain function
host_verification.mapping_arithmetic: Passed zero, overflow, inclusive endpoint and page-span checks in the shared helper; native DMA/IOMMU transactions are not modeled
host_verification.display_protocol: Passed actual bridge mode switch/rollback/reconnect, stable IDs, fixed-allocation limits, invalid EDID, timing bounds and one-based DDC block checks on Windows; native macOS compile/IOFramebuffer scheduling remains a CI/hardware boundary.

hardware_test_readiness.policy: Do not ask the user for another boot test while the source completeness review and remaining code blockers are open.
remaining_code_review: Verify native single-display EDID/mode/notification integration and lifecycle through CI; initial scanout allocation cannot grow dynamically
Establish native sleep/wake and per-device IOMMU/resource ownership contracts for the supported configuration
Build/package the matched Intel userland components and implement/test WindowServer admission, IOSurface and presentation contracts
